results.consentNote: Well done to every participant. We only display recognition where the participant or their guardian has agreed to public credit. Other results remain private.
results.noPublicAwards: There are no consented credits to show at present.
results.prepareHelp: Select the locked final round. Recognition and prize instructions will be frozen for a second staff member to review. No award is inferred from an unscored entry.
results.scheduleHelp: Enter the date and time in Indian Standard Time. Approval must be complete before this instant.
results.deliveryHelp: Explain how winners or their guardians will receive their prize or recognition. Use 10–500 characters and no personal details.
results.unavailable: Only a competition manager can prepare results once a final round has been locked and FOA judging is complete.
results.auctionSuitability: Tagged suitable for auction (consent is separate)
results.snapshotHelp: These are the exact awards that the approval releases. The public page resolves consent separately; names and score sheets are not part of the release.
results.noAwards: No recognition was tagged in this locked round.
results.approvalHelp: Review the awards, scheduled instant and delivery instructions before approving. Approval requires a fresh second factor.
results.selfApproval: A different authorised staff member must approve these results.
results.rejectHelp: Reject this release to stop its publication. The manager can prepare another release.

notices.invalid_date: Enter a valid date and time.
notices.competition_not_judging: Results cannot be prepared or approved in this competition status.
notices.final_round_required: Select a locked round with no active subsequent round.
notices.publish_time_required: Choose a future publication instant. Reject an expired release and prepare another.
notices.release_exists: A release already exists for this competition.
notices.second_staff_required: A different staff member must approve the release.
notices.release_not_reviewable: This release can no longer be reviewed.
notices.release_changed: The release has changed. Reject it and prepare another.
